findings.title: A lowered wing becomes willing shelter
findings.claim: Lowering a wing toward the parents makes humility an act of protective care: the speaker who remembers being raised small turns a lowered posture into a chosen shelter for those who once cared for them.
findings.mechanism: The carriers are the imperative to lower, the wing/side image, mercy-shaped yielding, and the remembered raising of the speaker as small. The paired lowering-and-raising at 56:3, near shade and accessible fruit at 76:14, coerced abasement at 26:4 and 27:37, and the ruler's claim of childhood raising at 26:18 meet those carriers in different ways. Their contact makes the focus's lowering read as chosen, practical shelter whose remembered nurture becomes a reason for care.
findings.reader_payoff: A reader can see how lowering becomes a way to make protection and care available, while the remembered childhood gives that posture a reciprocal direction.
findings.containment: The focus does not state the speaker's current age. The wider scenes are contrasts and analogies, not the same speakers or circumstances; their morphology is not supplied. The focus remains a command for mercy-shaped conduct toward the parents.

epistemic.reason: The cross-run record is trusted and names exact focus anchors and branch refs; the represented walk is legacy_unbound, and wider target verses provide Arabic text without morphology. The age and cross-context contacts therefore remain qualified.

findings.title: The wing carries a wider social posture
findings.claim: The lowered wing toward the parents also belongs to a wider register of gentle shelter: the same wing image is directed elsewhere toward believers and followers, making this a way of approaching people in one's care as well as a filial posture.
findings.mechanism: The focus carries the protective-side image in جَنَاحَ, lowered by the imperative and directed toward the parents. The exact lowered-wing phrases at 26:215 and 15:88 name followers and believers as other recipients; 8:61 adds the root's distinct image of reciprocal inclination toward peace. Their contact changes the wing from a parent-only emblem into a directed posture that can extend across relationships.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see parent-directed tenderness as one instance of protective, directed care, alongside a wider form of humane leadership.
findings.containment: The other passages have different recipients and circumstances; their target morphology is not supplied. They illuminate the focus's posture without replacing its specific address to parents or claiming that this scene is a peace negotiation.

epistemic.reason: The reader-walk source is legacy_unbound and its 17:23/17:26 context was excluded. The retained reading is supported by supplied target Arabic and connection notes, but target morphology is absent.

findings.containment: The focus does not enumerate pregnancy, birth, or weaning, and the external passages do not describe the same speaker. Their details enrich the life-stage image without becoming a translation of this ayah.

findings.title: Care continues as intercession
findings.claim: After the body is lowered toward the parents, the focus turns care into spoken intercession: the speaker asks God to show them mercy, carrying filial concern beyond what the speaker's own posture can do.
findings.mechanism: The carrier is قُلْ رَبِّ ٱرْحَمْهُمَا. The same say-my-Lord-and-mercy frame appears at 23:118, while 14:41 and 71:28 place parents within prayers for forgiveness alongside wider communities. These contacts make the focus's second act legible as a recurring form of care entrusted to God, following the human posture toward the parents.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader can see the prayer as another act of filial care, extending the relation into a request for divine action.
findings.containment: 14:41 and 71:28 ask for forgiveness rather than using the same mercy verb, and 23:118 does not name parents. The parallels do not assert a shared quotation or erase the focus's specific request for mercy.

epistemic.reason: The supplied contexts contain exact prayer text and explicit relation notes, but their morphology is not supplied and the wider link is contextual.
